name: Boulangère Potatoes
assumptions: Yield estimated from typical 1.5kg potato gratin recipes serving 6 as a side dish.
Total time is sum of ~5 min frying + 50-60 min baking (using upper end); oven preheating not added as unspecified.
Thyme sprigs treated as leaves only for classification (stems removed before or during eating).
Vegetable stock treated as compatible with all listed diets (no meat, dairy, or gluten assumed).
No wheat, barley, rye, or oats present; gluten-free confirmed via ingredients.
No dairy, eggs, fish, shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, or sesame listed.
instructions:
Heat oven to 200C/fan 180C/gas 6. Fry the onions and thyme sprigs in the oil until softened and lightly coloured (about 5 mins).
Spread a layer of potatoes over the base of a 1.5-litre oiled gratin dish. Sprinkle over a few onions (see picture, above) and continue layering, finishing with a layer of potatoes. Pour over the stock and bake for 50-60 mins until the potatoes are cooked and the top is golden and crisp.

ingredients.name: Onions
ingredients.assumptions: 2 medium onions at ~110g each, raw weight, finely chopped as per recipe; typical white/yellow onion values.

ingredients.name: Thyme
ingredients.assumptions: A few sprigs of fresh thyme estimated at 10g total (plausible small bunch for flavoring the onions); standard fresh thyme nutrient profile.

ingredients.name: Olive Oil
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tablespoons olive oil; standard density ~13.5g per tbsp, used for frying onions as instructed.

ingredients.name: Potatoes
ingredients.assumptions: 1.5kg potatoes, raw peeled weight typical for Boulangère Potatoes recipe; standard white potato values, as they are layered and baked.

ingredients.name: Vegetable Stock
ingredients.assumptions: 425g vegetable stock (as measured); typical low-calorie stock values, poured over the layered dish before baking.
